items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins for Sunday at Indianapolis due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; official Friday ruling by team, reported by Schefter and Rapoport.
items.implication: Houston WR1 out; elevated TE/WR2 opportunity vs IND.
items.opportunity: Target/route share spike for remaining pass-catchers

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip/groin) will not practice Friday, listed doubtful vs Broncos; McVay expects return next week vs Eagles barring setback. No IR consideration.
items.why: No practice all week; McVay update via Schefter/Rapoport/Barshop.
items.implication: Likely second straight miss; Adams remains primary WR.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) will not be placed on IR; surgery not on table. Week-to-week, aiming return ASAP. Mariota starts vs SEA.
items.why: GM Peters and Quinn: imaging/specialists; no surgery/IR discussed.
items.implication: Positive for ROS; shorter absence than feared. Mariota short-term.
items.opportunity: Mariota spot-start; McLaurin usage with backup QB

items.text: With Dowdle out, Steelers RB coach says Warren will lead the group and get breathers as needed. Expect PS Homer and rookie Heidenreich as backups. Vertical game failing for Rodgers; more checkdowns to Warren likely.
items.why: Coach comment + Dowdle OUT confirmation; routes/targets context.
items.implication: Warren clear lead if active (Q shoulder); high checkdown volume.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps, carries, targets for Warren

items.text: Packers first game without Jayden Reed (neck/back): on 55 Love dropbacks, Watson 45 routes, Golden 44, Moore 27. Watson & Golden combined 48% of Love targets so far.
items.implication: Watson/Golden clear primary WRs; strong opportunity.
items.opportunity: High route participation and target share

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected on IR (core); only 5 games in 3 seasons. Pushes Chuba Hubbard firmly to lead role (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
items.opportunity: Full lead back snaps/carries for Hubbard

items.text: Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: 30% routes targeted / 28% target share last week sans Collins. IND allows 4th-most yards to TEs.
items.why: Usage spike confirmed with Collins out again + matchup.

items.text: Kyle Pitts only 63% route participation this season, six targets (8% share) through three games. TPRR last two years: 33% with London off, 17% with London on.
items.why: Season-long low routes/targets; London on-field suppresses share.
items.implication: Fade Pitts while London healthy; low opportunity.
items.opportunity: Limited; better only if London out

items.text: Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); Dallas 30th in rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.implication: Strong start vs weak run D.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches and 15% target share both games; RB7 utilization (86). PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit targets both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards. LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
items.why: Target volume + deep threat vs soft secondary.

items.text: Hates Rhamondre Stevenson @ JAX: 31% snaps/5 touches after fumble last week. JAX allows only 55 rush ypg (3.2 YPC). Still ranks him over Henderson but gap narrowed.
items.why: Post-fumble role loss + tough matchup. 10 Facts: Henderson 65% snaps/16-5 touches after Stevenson fumble.
items.implication: Sit or cautious; Henderson rising but not full takeover yet.
items.opportunity: Reduced for Stevenson; watch Henderson snaps
items.conflict: Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead short-term
